scope_and_limits: This is a source inventory and requirements list for a component that DOES NOT EXIST.
NO seam is implemented between the repaired FFN and any peer, on either side.
No privacy claim is made and no blocker is closed (B1, B2, B5, A3, A4 all unchanged).
No cryptographic construction is proposed; every missing argument is handed to Codex in unresolved_for_codex.
No Rust was changed, no cargo was run, no GPU was used, no proof was produced.
Row offsets and slot lengths are recomputed from the layout rules, never copied from a capture.
Line numbers are pinned to the worktree HEAD and will move; O3/O4 numbers were taken at a8a1bc7.
